analysis.description: This living room features a contemporary design with modern furniture and sleek finishes, yet it incorporates traditional Indian elements, particularly in the framed artwork, which is a common practice in Indian interior design. The use of marble and gold accents, along with the high ceiling and tall wall paneling, reflect Northern Indian architectural styles. The space is organized with an open layout, maximizing the visual impact of the large window and the grandeur of the room's design. The color palette is soft and harmonious, with beige, white, and gold tones, complemented by the natural green of the plant, creating a calming and luxurious atmosphere.

metadata.budget_indicator: Mid to high, as indicated by the use of materials like marble and gold finishes
metadata.indian_specific: Framed artwork, use of marble and gold accents, high ceiling and wall paneling
